shows.title: AI Discovery System / Dreams & Emotions
shows.first_half: First Half: Nick Begich is an author, researcher, and longtime investigator of emerging and unconventional technologies. He'll share his efforts to develop a human-AI discovery system designed to encourage radical creativity while subjecting extraordinary ideas to evidence,  testing, and the possibility of failure.
shows.second_half: Second Half: Clinical psychologist Edward Bruce Bynum will explore the emotionally revealing world of dreams, examining how they may be deeply intertwined with the lives of those closest to us, including family members and romantic partners, and the patterns that shape our lives.

shows.title: Tribute to Nick Pope / Paranormal Investigations
shows.first_half: First Half: Join us for a tribute to author, UFO researcher, and former British Ministry of Defense investigator Nick Pope, who passed away earlier this year. Researcher Jason Martell will reflect on Pope’s legacy as a ufologist and civil servant, along with guest appearances from author William Henry, filmmaker James Fox, and Professor Paul Hynek.
shows.second_half: Second Half: Author Victoria Gross will share insights from her years of paranormal investigations and producing paranormal TV programs. She'll explore different types of hauntings and other phenomena, while emphasizing the importance of proper training and ethical practices in paranormal research.

shows.title: Bridging the Divide / The SoulPhone
shows.guests: Jim Gray, Cheryll Jones, Gary Schwartz
shows.first_half: First Half: James P. Gray has served as a trial judge in Orange County, California, since 1983. He will discuss and offer solutions to pressing issues, including society's growing polarization, the burden of debt passed on to future generations, school choice, the current state of government, and more.
shows.second_half: Second Half: C2C's investigative reporter Cheryll Jones presents her interview with parapsychologist Dr. Gary Schwartz, who discusses the possibility of communicating with the afterlife through what he calls the SoulPhone.

shows.title: Haunted Bellaire House / Open Lines
shows.first_half: Joining guest host Ryan Wrecker (email), paranormal investigator Kristin Lee shares nearly two decades of experience at the Bellaire House in Ohio, one of America’s best-known paranormal locations. She'll report on the unusual activity at the property and why she believes the Bellaire House is more than a traditional haunted house. According to Lee, the environment seems to respond to each person who enters, producing different experiences and encounters from one visitor to the next. Followed by Open Lines in the latter half. Give Ryan a call and discuss whatever is on your mind!
